speaker: Armorer Kesh
text: You have the weapon. Leave the armory intact so the route stays available after the fighting starts.

speaker: Armorer Kesh
text: Detaching is not quitting. The armory session will remain alive — you can attach back to it from the bridge manifest.

speaker: HELIX
text: Ctrl+b is the prefix. Press it, then press d. You will return to the bridge and the armory Rift stays open.

speaker: HELIX
text: Detach from the session and I will lift you back to the bridge.
